what: Provenance of T162-no-regression-rows.csv: the state of the tree the AC21 comparison rows were measured against. test_hrv_no_regression_gate.py asserts measured_module.blob_sha against the module in this checkout and FAILS when they differ, because the rows are a snapshot of a measurement and the gate over them proves nothing about a rule that has changed since.

rows.committed_by_subject: test(T164): re-measure the gate and name the deferred forbidden-rate exception

measured_module.sha_kind: git blob sha1 -- sha1("blob <bytes>\0" + contents) over the file with CRLF folded to LF, which is what `git hash-object` prints and what the object store holds; the fold is what keeps the pin platform-independent on a CRLF checkout
measured_module.introduced_by_subject: fix(T164): widen AC7's recency reference set, closing the stale-band regression
measured_module.note: The rows were re-measured after this commit landed and the same blob is still HEAD's, so this records a fact about the tree as it stands and required no re-measurement to write (verified 2026-09-20: `git rev-parse b06ec6d:<path>`, `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` and `git hash-object <path>` all print it).

compared_against.what: shipped F005 -- the module the comparison's f005 column was produced by
compared_against.ref_subject: docs(rules): graduate two learnings from F005's tenth review cycle

harness.path: spec/references/T130-overlap-sweep-harness.py (Shipyard data dir; gitignored, reached through the .shipyard breadcrumb)
harness.sha_kind: git blob sha1 of the working file -- the harness is not committed, so this is `git hash-object` over the data-dir copy and not a sha the repository can resolve
harness.note: Recorded for provenance only. The gate does not assert on it: the harness lives where the gate is explicitly built not to require anything (a worktree or a runner has no data dir), so an assertion on it would be a skip, and this project distrusts skips as gates.

remeasure.why: Any change to the measured module's blob invalidates these rows: the gate would then be comparing shipped F005 against a rule nobody has swept.
remeasure.command: uv run --package runcoach-api python .shipyard/spec/references/T130-overlap-sweep-harness.py t162-gate --f005 <shipped F005 module, `git show 42f7705:runcoach-api/src/runcoach_api/metrics/hrv_trend.py`> --rows .shipyard/spec/references/T162-no-regression-rows.csv --procs <n>
remeasure.runtime: ~13 minutes at --procs 16 on an otherwise idle machine (1,353,000 judgings)
remeasure.then: re-commit the regenerated runcoach-api/tests/data/T162-no-regression-rows.csv, the mirrored spec/references/F006-no-regression-report.md, and this file with the new measured_module.blob_sha, its introducing commit and today's date.
